name: Aria: The Multimodal AI Kiosk
tagline: An airport kiosk with a 3D voice assistant that answers questions, shows flight status and rebooks.

awards: Second Place for American Airlines Challenge

problem: Airport help desks are crowded and information is scattered.
solution: Face or QR login, a 3D animated assistant by voice or text, RAG answers on airport policies, flight and weather info and rebooking, orchestrated with LangGraph.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask about a delayed flight and get rebooked.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Vultr” and “Second Place for American Airlines Challenge” among 176 submissions.
Also placed in the airline challenge.

lessons: A kiosk demo is concrete: one screen, one traveller, one fix.
